Heading to Boston next week for the Electron Maintainer Summit 2026! 🍁✨

This is @igalia@floss.social 's first time attending EMS. Working closely on #Chromium, I'm looking forward to connecting with #ElectronJS maintainers, discussing upstream platform developments, and exploring deeper alignment between the browser engine and app runtime layers.

Let me know if you'll be there or tuning in virtually!
